summary: Worksport Ltd filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for a registered direct offering of 208,333 shares of common stock and common warrants to purchase up to 208,333 additional shares (cashless exercise yields up to 291,667 shares). The combined public offering price is $1.20 per unit; warrants have a $1.50 exercise price, immediate exercisability, and five-year term. The last reported sale price was $0.5983 per share on June 17, 2026. D. Boral Capital LLC serves as placement agent without obligation to purchase. No special-situation event; filing is an ordinary equity shelf takedown.
